state: Classify the supplied GBA screenshot using only visible evidence. A screenshot does not prove live player control versus a demo.

questions.name: gameplay
questions.instructions: Is this screenshot showing in-world gameplay or a player-facing battle?
questions.true_description: Exploration, platforming, racing, combat, or a tactical board; a HUD is allowed.
questions.false_description: Title, menu, logo, blank transition, or story narration without an active battle.

choices.description: Player-facing battle, card battle or tactical board
Title, name/file selection, settings or inventory
Story scene or narration without an active battle
Logo, legal text, blank, loading or transition

questions.name: visible_mechanics_evidence
questions.instructions: How much observable evidence of game mechanics is visible? This is a triage signal, not proof of internal implementation.

levels.label: limited
levels.description: One visible interaction, HUD resource or board rule

levels.label: rich
levels.description: Several distinct interactions, resources or rules visible together
